issues.problem: Unsupported and unverifiable. No source is cited for it, and nothing I could open states the status of the firm's 2025 filings. The only regulator filing traceable to the firm is a DOL Form 5500 entry whose page does not state a plan year, and the 2025-dated items in the file are municipal project documents (Old Bridge CIS 16 Jul 2025; Raritan plans revised Apr/Aug 2025), not company filings. As worded it also reads like insider/regulatory knowledge, which breaks the tone rule.
issues.fix: Replace with the sourced, dated fact: e.g. "Your plans are still moving through review — a July 2025 Old Bridge subdivision document and Raritan plans revised in April and August 2025."

issues.claim: Section 3: "an Old Bridge plat from July 2025"; Sources line: "Old Bridge preliminary plat dated 16 July 2025, signed for the firm by Sharif H. Aly, PE NJ Lic. 34669"
issues.problem: The document at the cited URL is not a plat. It is an 8-page Community Impact Statement for the Brookside Villas major subdivision (Block 24303, Lot 29.11, Old Bridge), dated 16 July 2025 and signed "For the Firm" by Sharif H. Aly, PE NJ Lic. 34669. Amertech is named as preparer only in that report's reference list, as author of the "Preliminary Plat - Major Subdivision, Brookside Estates" - and that plat carries no July 2025 date anywhere I could see. So the document type and the date attribution are both wrong as stated.
issues.fix: Say "a July 2025 Community Impact Statement for an Old Bridge subdivision that cites Amertech's preliminary plat" and describe the signature as on that report, not on the plat.

issues.claim: Notes: "The wage page was read for the New Jersey civil engineer median ($104,660 ...); its data year was not captured, so confirm before quoting the rate"
issues.problem: Contradicted by the page itself. The O*NET local-wages page states "Source: Bureau of Labor Statistics 2025 wage data", and industry.json records the same figure as "2025 (BLS OEWS, May 2025)". The data year was available, so the caveat is inaccurate (it errs safe but is factually wrong).
issues.fix: Delete the caveat and cite it as BLS OEWS May 2025 data republished by O*NET, New Jersey statewide.

issues.claim: Sources: engineerjobs.io/amertech-engineering-inc cited for "posting (5-8 years, NJ PE, prepares proposals), closed about 6 August 2026"
issues.problem: Citation is imprecise: the company listing page shows only two closed postings and the "4mo ago" closed labels - the 5-8 years / NJ PE / "Prepare proposals for professional services" text is on the individual posting. I confirmed all of it (and "Closed on August 6, 2026") on the posting itself.
issues.fix: Cite https://engineerjobs.io/job/professional-civil-engineer-1010452 for the requirements and closed date; keep the company page for the "no open positions" point.

issues.claim: Opening: "about ten towns with plans cycling through review rounds"
issues.problem: The count of ten towns is confirmed, and revision cycles are confirmed for Raritan and Old Bridge, but presenting "plans cycling through review rounds" as a property of the ten-town portfolio is a generalisation from two examples and is not labelled as an inference.
issues.fix: Add a two-word hedge, e.g. "ten towns, and the two whose files we could open show review rounds repeating".

issues.claim: Section 1: "the header email link is a placeholder address" / Impact: "one confirmed contact route restored"
issues.problem: Not wrong, but understated: the contact page has a second placeholder mailto (the visible main@amertechengineering.com text links to mailto:info@consultant.com), so more than one route is dead.
issues.fix: Optional strengthening: mention both placeholder links, which makes the front-door case stronger rather than weaker.
